notes.title: We have made it easier to activate Reverse and Slow while holding down the butto
notes.notes:
We have released TimeK 1.0.4.

Previously, the Reverse and Slow abilities were only triggered based on the timing of pressing the button. Now, we have made it possible to activate them immediately when the button is pressed and the abilities are available.

We have also fixed display-related issues in the editor.

Thank you for your continued support and feedback!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43725375/b2ef3f13449daf9f190f09422100d8bef61f1df7.gif[/img]

notes.title: We have unlocked the demo version up to Stage 13.
notes.notes:
Today, we have updated the TimeK Demo to version 1.0.3a.

With this update, you can now play without restrictions up to Stage 13.

For those who are playing TimeK for the first time, reaching Stage 13 will likely take a significant amount of time. If you are unsure about making a purchase, why not give it a try and play until Stage 13?

Stage 13, in particular, is one that I personally enjoy. It takes place in a dimly lit cave, and you progress through its challenges.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43725375/a160720c4aef19391757f9ee1ee813b6bfb29281.png[/img]
